hypotheses.claim: ARC-published approximate hypothesis: at recurrence step t, neuron 1 approximates max(0, x_0, ..., x_(t-4), x_(t-2), x_(t-1)) - x_(t-1). Assumptions: ARC rescales hidden units and identifies the relevant subcircuit through approximate weight sparsity and approximate isolation. Uncertainty: the source does not quantify approximation error and states that it becomes increasingly significant for more complex neurons. This claim is proposed background, not an independently validated interpretation. Source: https://www.alignment.org/blog/algzoo-uninterpreted-models-with-fewer-than-1-500-parameters/ ("Hidden size 16, sequence length 10").
